selections.title: The Manor
selections.summary: A dark fantasy text adventure with tactical dice combat, resource management and roguelite progression. Explore through different vessels, carry knowledge between runs and decide when to retreat. The creator shared a browser demo with about two hours of content.
selections.reason: Named playable game, individually reviewed against the current public Reddit post after a user reported it missing. Current source evidence supersedes stale archived flair and moderation metadata.

selections.title: Cemetery Designer
selections.summary: A cemetery-building prototype where players gather resources, craft headstones and decorate the grounds. The creator shared gameplay and asked for feedback on the art and atmosphere; no public build was linked.
selections.reason: July 20 gameplay showcase with the project flair. The game describes a concrete gathering, crafting and placement loop; it remained pending because its post did not use the collector's first-person wording. The title is an editorial description, not a claimed official name.

selections.title: Reef Shark and Shore
selections.summary: A relaxing multiplayer reef sandbox. Create a shark, watch it swim or take control, and invite friends into the same reef. This update adds moving algae and multiplayer, with a linked browser build.
selections.reason: Named interactive project with the project flair, gameplay video and a public build link, confirmed on its current Reddit page. The keyword detector missed it because the post described sharks and multiplayer without explicitly saying game.
